description: Health and ingestion stats for the OSRS GE price database in InfluxDB 3 (table itemPrice). ALL panels are bounded by the dashboard time picker so they stay fast and never do a whole-store scan (which trips the query file limit). Every metric therefore reflects the SELECTED TIME RANGE, not the entire store. Widen the range to see more history.
title: OSRS GE Database & Ingestion Stats

panels.title: Records stored (in range)
panels.description: COUNT(*) over itemPrice within the selected time range. Bounded by the time picker so it stays fast (no whole-store scan). Widen the range to count more history.

targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "records" FROM "itemPrice" WHERE time >= $__timeFrom() AND time <= $__timeTo()
targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "records" FROM "itemPrice" WHERE time >= $__timeFrom() AND time <= $__timeTo()

panels.title: Distinct items (in range)
panels.description: Number of distinct itemID tags seen within the selected time range. Bounded by the time picker (no whole-store scan).

targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "itemID") AS "items" FROM "itemPrice" WHERE time >= $__timeFrom() AND time <= $__timeTo()
targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "itemID") AS "items" FROM "itemPrice" WHERE time >= $__timeFrom() AND time <= $__timeTo()

panels.title: Snapshots captured (in range)
panels.description: Distinct 5-minute timestamps within the selected time range (each snapshot fans out to ~3k item rows). Bounded by the time picker (no whole-store scan).

targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT time) AS "snapshots" FROM "itemPrice" WHERE time >= $__timeFrom() AND time <= $__timeTo()
targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT time) AS "snapshots" FROM "itemPrice" WHERE time >= $__timeFrom() AND time <= $__timeTo()

panels.title: Data freshness (latest in range)
panels.description: Timestamp of the most recent stored row within the selected time range, shown as age-from-now. With a range ending at 'now' and the 5-minute catch-up running this should stay within a few minutes; a large age means ingestion has stalled (or the range ends in the past). Bounded by the time picker (no whole-store scan).

targets.queryText: SELECT MAX(time) AS "latest" FROM "itemPrice" WHERE time >= $__timeFrom() AND time <= $__timeTo()
targets.rawSql: SELECT MAX(time) AS "latest" FROM "itemPrice" WHERE time >= $__timeFrom() AND time <= $__timeTo()

panels.title: Earliest snapshot (in range)
panels.description: Oldest stored row within the selected time range. Bounded by the time picker (no whole-store scan) — this is the earliest data in the selected window, not necessarily the earliest in the whole store.

targets.queryText: SELECT MIN(time) AS "earliest" FROM "itemPrice" WHERE time >= $__timeFrom() AND time <= $__timeTo()
targets.rawSql: SELECT MIN(time) AS "earliest" FROM "itemPrice" WHERE time >= $__timeFrom() AND time <= $__timeTo()

panels.title: Latest snapshot (in range)
panels.description: Most recent stored row within the selected time range (absolute timestamp). Bounded by the time picker (no whole-store scan).

targets.queryText: SELECT MAX(time) AS "latest" FROM "itemPrice" WHERE time >= $__timeFrom() AND time <= $__timeTo()
targets.rawSql: SELECT MAX(time) AS "latest" FROM "itemPrice" WHERE time >= $__timeFrom() AND time <= $__timeTo()

panels.title: Records written per hour
panels.description: Row count binned into 1-hour buckets over the selected time range. Reflects when snapshots landed in the store (both the 5-minute catch-up and any backfill writes that fall in-range). Bounded by the time picker so it stays fast.

targets.queryText: SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '1 hour', time) AS time, COUNT(*) AS "records" FROM "itemPrice" WHERE time >= $__timeFrom() AND time <= $__timeTo() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
targets.rawSql: SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '1 hour', time) AS time, COUNT(*) AS "records" FROM "itemPrice" WHERE time >= $__timeFrom() AND time <= $__timeTo() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Distinct items per hour
panels.description: How many distinct items reported in each 1-hour bucket over the selected range. A steady line near the total item count means snapshots are arriving complete.

targets.queryText: SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '1 hour', time) AS time, COUNT(DISTINCT "itemID") AS "items" FROM "itemPrice" WHERE time >= $__timeFrom() AND time <= $__timeTo() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
targets.rawSql: SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '1 hour', time) AS time, COUNT(DISTINCT "itemID") AS "items" FROM "itemPrice" WHERE time >= $__timeFrom() AND time <= $__timeTo() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Snapshots (distinct timestamps) per hour
panels.description: Distinct 5-minute snapshot timestamps landing in each 1-hour bucket. A fully-covered hour has 12 snapshots; dips reveal gaps being filled or missed windows.

targets.queryText: SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '1 hour', time) AS time, COUNT(DISTINCT time) AS "snapshots" FROM "itemPrice" WHERE time >= $__timeFrom() AND time <= $__timeTo() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
targets.rawSql: SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '1 hour', time) AS time, COUNT(DISTINCT time) AS "snapshots" FROM "itemPrice" WHERE time >= $__timeFrom() AND time <= $__timeTo() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: History coverage & per-item volume (within selected time range)
Records per day (in range)
panels.description: Row count per calendar day within the selected time range. Bounded by the time picker so it stays fast (no whole-store scan). Widen the range to see more of the historical footprint.

targets.queryText: SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '1 day', time) AS time, COUNT(*) AS "records" FROM "itemPrice" WHERE time >= $__timeFrom() AND time <= $__timeTo() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
targets.rawSql: SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '1 day', time) AS time, COUNT(*) AS "records" FROM "itemPrice" WHERE time >= $__timeFrom() AND time <= $__timeTo() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Top 20 items by rows (in range)
panels.description: Items with the most stored rows within the selected time range. Bounded by the time picker (no whole-store scan).

targets.queryText: SELECT "itemID", COUNT(*) AS "records" FROM "itemPrice" WHERE time >= $__timeFrom() AND time <= $__timeTo() GROUP BY "itemID" ORDER BY "records" DESC LIMIT 20
targets.rawSql: SELECT "itemID", COUNT(*) AS "records" FROM "itemPrice" WHERE time >= $__timeFrom() AND time <= $__timeTo() GROUP BY "itemID" ORDER BY "records" DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Most recently updated items (in range)
panels.description: Items whose latest stored snapshot is newest within the selected time range. All items should share (roughly) the same latest timestamp when the 5-minute catch-up is healthy. Bounded by the time picker (no whole-store scan).

targets.queryText: SELECT "itemID", MAX(time) AS "last_seen" FROM "itemPrice" WHERE time >= $__timeFrom() AND time <= $__timeTo() GROUP BY "itemID" ORDER BY "last_seen" DESC LIMIT 20
targets.rawSql: SELECT "itemID", MAX(time) AS "last_seen" FROM "itemPrice" WHERE time >= $__timeFrom() AND time <= $__timeTo() GROUP BY "itemID" ORDER BY "last_seen" DESC LIMIT 20
